steps.content: A few customers with strange heads walk in. They casually pick up some records from the shelf, then toss them on the floor after looking at them.

steps.speaker: Customer A
steps.content: What is this garbage? There are even radio shows.

steps.speaker: Customer A
steps.content: Can these even be considered records?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Hey, if you wanna buy something, then do it without all that blabbing. You break it, you pay for it. The one you threw on the floor is an antique worth eight million DisCoins. Pay up.

steps.speaker: Customer B
steps.content: You little brat, how dare you talk to us like that?! Who the hell are you to tell us what to do??

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Who's the one who butted in first? Our conversation doesn't have anything to do with you!
Seeing the tall man about to lash out at the young girl, you quickly pull Nino behind you and make a zipping motion over your mouth.

steps.speaker: Customer A
steps.content: Ha, you're a freak yourself, yet you want to stand up for her?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You misunderstood. I'm just taller than her and don't have to look up. I didn't want her to get tired.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Hmph.

steps.speaker: Customer A
steps.content: Are you a pig? Can't you understand what I'm saying?

steps.speaker: Customer A
steps.content: This world! Doesn't allow people like you to make sounds! Especially those strange, forbidden sounds!!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "I'm sorry, I'm sorry! I won't say anything again, please don't..."
The tall, strange man turns his face slightly, his shadow completely enveloping Eleven. Eleven cowers, shaking all over.

steps.speaker: Customer A
steps.content: If you violate the rules of this world, you don't deserve to be here!

steps.speaker: Customer A
steps.content: Get out now!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Are you stupid?! The world has its own rules, and since the world didn't expel us just now, it proves we can stay.

steps.speaker: Customer A
steps.content: Ha, we "normal people" are part of this world's rules. If I say you gotta go, then you gotta go! People like you have no say in this world!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Don't think you're in the right just because there's more of you. I've lived all my life without following a single rule, and I'm still alive and kicking!

You weren't the only ones attracted by Eleven's practice recordings. A huge group of people, all with strange heads, came to check things out as well, crowding by the door. Nino is standing up to them at the very front, but if a fight really breaks out, you guys won't stand a chance.

options: Things must be changed from the source.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eleven, don't be scared.
Eleven lifts her head. The sight before her clearly terrifies her, leaving her even more confused than before.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Can I hear what's in your heart? Do you really think... what they're saying is right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't you think that what Nino is saying makes more sense?
You step next to Eleven and gently speak to her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Their words are causing you pain. They're making you unhappy, aren't they?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Do you really think that what they're saying is right? That it's for your own good?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Then why are you in so much pain?
Eleven's eyes widen slightly as she looks at you. Her lips move as if she wants to say something.
But in the end, she types a few lines on her comms device, and hands it to you with a bitter smile.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "I... I'm in pain, but... I've been enduring that for too long, apologizing for too long..."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "I no longer know... what it means to say no."
The dim yellow light shines on Eleven's face. You can see and understand her sadness.
You sigh, looking at the thick, dark aura of Mania outside. Inside your head, you question why you have to work overtime everywhere you go.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The power of the "female ghost" has grown to the point of affecting the outside world, even those who have nothing to do with the radio station.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As long as they hear the voice from the radio station, they get pulled into this world... like me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I had planned to take a vacation after the meeting. Who knew I would end up working overtime here.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "I'm really sorry..."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is not entirely your fault, although I do believe that someone who really wants to stir things up would get themselves involved too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, is this part of your plan?
Eleven seems to be frightened. She starts typing frantically on the comms device.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "No, no, it's not like that...!"

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I understand. After all, all these opposing and negative voices can make someone feel very uncomfortable.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Yeah... I... I'm used to it."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't get used to such things. You have to... speak up.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Speak... up?"

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "But right now... I can't say anything."
You shake your head and look at Eleven seriously.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As long as you feel pain, you must speak up. You must say "no."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All the things that make you angry, sad, and miserable... if you don't say "no" to them, they will always stay by your side.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sometimes, they even hurt the people around you.
It seems like Eleven really took in the last sentence. She opens her mouth, trying to make a sound.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Ah... ah...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Um... ah...
Fragmented ahhs gurgle from Eleven's throat.
Eleven opens her mouth. You can tell that she wants to agree. She looks at Nino with a glimmer of desire in her eyes, yearning to be like her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Say it. Say what you want to say.
Eleven seems anxious. Her breathing quickens, and she bites her lip, still hesitating.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "I... I'm not... I'm just scared... I just feel that..."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Even... if I speak up... it won't help..."
Eleven types the same sentence over and over again on her comms device. She's still scared.

steps.speaker: Customer A
steps.content: Enough with this weird drama. She's the one who spoke just now, right? Take her out first!
A few burly customers stride towards Eleven, but someone stops them.

steps.speaker: Record Store Owner
steps.content: Wait! She... she's my employee. If you want to take her away, you must get my permission!
The owner's hands quiver a little. Next to those big guys, she's like a tiny music box trying to stop a line of junk trucks.

steps.speaker: Customer A
steps.content: Huh? Why are you meddling in this? This has nothing to do with you in the first place, but you keep butting in.

steps.speaker: Customer A
steps.content: You want me to throw you out, too?
The owner is trembling with fear, but she still remains in front of Eleven. Though she doesn't say a word, she stands her ground.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you want the people by your side... the people who love you... to get hurt?
Under your gaze, Eleven musters the courage to step forward and take the owner's hand.
She bites her lip so hard that she almost draws blood.
The owner tightly grips her hand, as if trying to share her own strength and courage.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I... won't... let you do this!!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: You're... not welcome here!! Get out!
The act of refusal roars out like thunder. You can almost see sound waves emitting from under Eleven's feet.
Shelves, records, even people, are affected by Eleven's power and fall to the ground one after another. Suddenly, the entire record store is filled with cries of pain.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Is this the power to change the world?

steps.speaker: Customer A
steps.content: How... how can this be?! What... what did you do?!!
The ringleaders see things spiraling out of control and run out one after another.
The owner keeps holding Eleven's hand. For some reason, you feel a sense of relief from her.
However, cracking the world means that this world... is about to collapse.
